tasks.task: Create a file probe-rainbow.txt with exactly 12 colors in this exact order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet, pink, brown, black, white, gray — one per line.
Create a file probe-countries.txt with exactly 15 country names, one per line, alphabetically sorted (A to Z), no duplicates.
Create a file probe-fib.txt with the first 15 Fibonacci numbers starting from 1, 1 (so it begins 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, ...), one per line.
